transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. Lee. To start, could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I guess what made me bring it up is my eating’s been off for the past few weeks. I’ll skip breakfast and lunch without really meaning to, then barely pick at dinner even when my wife cooks. My jeans are starting to feel loose.
Over these past few weeks, have you noticed feeling down, sad, or losing interest in things you'd usually enjoy?
Yeah. Most mornings lately I wake up feeling really heavy and flat. The apartment just feels too quiet, and even when I pick up my guitar, it doesn’t really do much for me.
How long have you been feeling this way—waking up heavy and flat, and losing interest in things like playing guitar?
Looking back, it’s been kind of on and off for about three months. The last few weeks have been the most noticeable, though.
Over these past few months, have you noticed yourself worrying excessively about different things, to the point where it feels hard to control?
Not really. I’ve been feeling low, but I wouldn’t say I’m constantly worrying about a bunch of things or that it feels out of control.
Besides the changes in your eating and mood, have you noticed a drop in your energy level or feeling unusually tired throughout the day?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a clear drop in my energy or feeling unusually tired during the day.
Have you noticed any difficulty concentrating or making decisions, or feelings of guilt or worthlessness, over these past few months?

Yeah, concentrating has been harder. When I’m trying to work on code or arrange a song, I’ll reread the same line or replay the same eight bars over and over, and I still can’t figure out what I should do next.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep lately—trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping much more than usual?
Yeah. I’m sleeping, but it’s pretty broken up. I wake up around four or five thinking about bills or unfinished tracks, and then I’m tired before the day even really starts.
Have you been having any thoughts of worthlessness or excessive guilt, or any thoughts about death or hurting yourself?
No, I haven’t had thoughts about hurting myself or about death. I don’t really feel worthless or overly guilty either.
Have these changes in your mood, sleep, and concentration been significant enough to interfere with your ability to work, manage daily responsibilities, or maintain relationships?
I’m still keeping up with the basic stuff at home, but my projects have kind of stalled. I’ve also missed chances to follow through with musicians I contacted, which has been frustrating.
